description: The chart illustrates counts of tasks by language-family category, split into three outcomes indicated by the legend title “better”: tasks where mBERT is better, tasks where XLM-R is better, and tasks where performance is the same. The horizontal axis contains the categorical labels (left to right): IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, with no additional axis label shown; the vertical axis is labeled “task count” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 40 with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, 30, and 40. Each category displays three adjacent bars: a light-blue bar for mBERT, a dark-blue bar for XLM-R, and a light-green bar for same. Approximate bar heights by category are: IE-Baltic (mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~10, same ~7), IE-Germanic (mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~18, same ~22), IE-Indic (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~4), IE-Romance (mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~13, same ~30), IE-Slavic (mBERT ~12, XLM-R ~39, same ~28), IE-other (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~6, same ~8), Isolate (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~1), Semitic (mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~7, same ~1), and Uralic (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~14, same ~5). The bars are grouped by category (not stacked), the categories appear in the fixed order shown rather than being sorted by bar height, and there are no special visual emphases such as annotations or outlines beyond the legend in the upper-right corner.
caption_used: The bar chart compares task counts across linguistic categories for mBERT and XLM-R models, alongside tasks where performance was the same. The horizontal axis lists categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents task count, ranging from 0 to 40. In the IE-Baltic category, XLM-R consistently outperforms mBERT, with task counts exceeding 15. IE-Germanic shows a notable decline in mBERT performance, with task counts below 5, while XLM-R and 'same' are roughly equal at around 20. IE-Slavic demonstrates the highest task count for XLM-R, surpassing 45, while mBERT remains stable at approximately 10 tasks. The Isolate category exhibits minimal variation, with all models performing similarly at around 5 tasks. The legend, located in the top right, clarifies the color coding for mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and 'same' (light green).
